'''''Max Reebo – Coruscant Nights''''' was an advertisement for the source of entertainment known as [[Coruscant Nights/Legends|Coruscant Nights]], put up as [[Painting/Legends|posters]] on the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The motif featured [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text on a dark background, reading "[[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Reebo]]" <small>''[sic]''</small> – "Coruscant Nights".<ref name="Lethal" /> The poster could be found in a [[Unidentified massage parlor/Legends|massage parlor]] in [[Slum district G17/Legends|Slum district G17]],<ref name="Lost">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref> the [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]],<ref name="Lethal" /> an [[Unidentified Coruscant cantina/Legends|unidentified cantina]]<ref name="Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> and the [[Refresher/Legends|latrine]] in the [[79's/Legends|79's]] cantina.<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref>
